verification.reason: No network egress; every claim is second-hand.
verification.artifact_note: The reporter located the official CSV/XLSX endpoints but could not materialise the bytes into a hashing runtime (Bundesbank MIME type application/vnd.bbk.data+csv; World Bank binary XLSX). It therefore supplied NO SHA-256 and NO row counts rather than fabricating them. That is an interface limitation, not data unavailability.

CORE.question_answered: Is a FTSE All-World Net Total Return monthly history of >=360 months obtainable AND redistributable in a public repository?
CORE.answer: No. LSEG's freely accessible Historic Index Values typically provide only about TWO YEARS of month-end values and returns. Longer historical index data is a licensed subscription product, and LSEG expressly requires a licence for use and distribution of index data.
CORE.redistribution_in_public_repo: not permitted without an LSEG/FTSE Russell licence

SECOND_SPECIFICATION_CORRECTION.finding: IE00BK5BQT80's official benchmark is FTSE All-World NR USD, not NR EUR. The fund's base currency is USD; EUR is a listing/trading currency only. LSEG's own FTSE All-World page maps the Vanguard ETF to 'FTSE All-World NR USD'.
SECOND_SPECIFICATION_CORRECTION.incorrect_model: benchmark = FTSE All-World NR EUR, asserted merely because the ETF trades in EUR
SECOND_SPECIFICATION_CORRECTION.note: LSEG does display a FTSE All-World EUR total-return variant publicly, but it is not established that this is the required NET-of-tax variant.

vanguard_nav_fallback.reason: Share class inception 2019-07-23, so at most ~7 years exist - far short of 360 months. Fund NAV is also net of fund fees and tracking, so it is not the benchmark series.

exact_source.detail: LBMA month-end PM fixing path remains licence-gated (MyLBMA / IBA).

open_proxy_found.definition: Gold (UK), 99.5% fine, London afternoon fixing, average of daily rates
open_proxy_found.difference_to_target: Target is LBMA PM MONTH-END. This proxy is the monthly AVERAGE of daily London afternoon fixings. Averaging suppresses month-end volatility and is not a substitute without a documented rule.
open_proxy_found.assessment: Unlike the Kenneth French candidate for CORE, this series genuinely meets the open-data requirement: institutional primary provider, long history, monthly, explicit licence, redistribution permitted.

HICP_EA.reporter_note: Do NOT extrapolate n_observations from start and end month. Parse and count the actual CSV.

SHORT_RATE_EA.description: Euro Short-Term Rate, monthly average; CSV and SDMX-ML both linked
SHORT_RATE_EA.eonia_rule_confirmed: From 2019-10-02 EONIA was computed as €STR + 8.5 bp; EONIA publication ended 2022-01-03.
SHORT_RATE_EA.critical_caveat: This does NOT create a €STR history before October 2019. Back-extension via legacy EONIA is a separate proxy/splice and must stay explicitly flagged.

BUND_LONG_YIELD.finding: The official Bundesbank migration catalogue contains NO entry for BBK01.WT3230. The candidate series is documented as the successor of WU9555 / WU0115, not of WT3230.
BUND_LONG_YIELD.candidate_concept: Umlaufsrenditen inländischer Inhaberschuldverschreibungen / börsennotierte Bundeswertpapiere / Monatswerte
BUND_LONG_YIELD.open_question: Should BUND_LONG_YIELD measure the aggregate Umlaufsrendite of all listed federal securities? The same Bundesbank table also carries maturity-band series (3-5, 5-8, 8-15, 15-30 years), and the Basiszins concept determines which is correct.

reporter_conclusion.reason: CORE exact benchmark history requires licensed FTSE Russell/LSEG data and cannot be redistributed as the public-repo policy requires.
reporter_conclusion.caveat: LICENCE_REQUIRED still does not mean the data does not exist. It means the project set itself an open-reproducibility condition that the exact dataset does not satisfy.
reporter_conclusion.recommendation: Do not start Phase 5. Ingest round 2 as a second external dossier. Once egress exists, R3 must download the official files itself, compute SHA-256, and promote only locally reproduced findings.
